name: Performance & Mobile Optimization
description: Image optimization (WebP/AVIF, Next.js Image), dynamic imports for heavy components, mobile-first responsive design, <2s initial load target
evidence: Added feat-005 product spec, guest image `sizes` prop, deferred Google Maps iframe behind user action, reduced story placeholder animation density, SectionWrapper optional animation disable. Verified pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm build on 2026-05-05. Deferred: full WebP/AVIF rollout blocked on real production photos; logged in docs/exec-plans/tech-debt-tracker.md. All currently shippable acceptance criteria met.
acceptanceCriteria: All images use Next.js Image component with proper sizing
Heavy components (story sections, gallery) lazy-loaded with next/dynamic
Mobile-first responsive design verified on 375px, 414px, 768px viewports
No layout shifts on image load
notes: This is a cross-cutting feature. Apply optimizations incrementally as other features are built.
